# sonarqube_project_links (Resource)

Provides a Sonarqube Project Links resource. This can be used to manage Sonarqube project links.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_project_links" "homepage" {
  project_key = "my_project"
  name        = "Homepage"
  url         = "https://example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the link.
- `project_key` (String) The key of the project to associate the link with.
- `url` (String) The URL of the link.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `type` (String) The type of the link, assigned by SonarQube.
